what: Follow-up to the OnceLock/LazyLock ban: process-wide statics that hold state now sit behind #[expect(clippy::disallowed_types)]. They are pick_cache PICKS/STEPS, tls_cache SHARED/OF_QUERY and their generation pools, the body_store and goal_store LIMBO, the layout hash-cons LAYOUTS, base-db trees INSTALLED, blaze-query ON_RUN and the count blocks FIRST. The ban asks for state built at start or as a query and passed down: move each into what owns its lifetime (the Storage, a database input, or a value the driver makes and hands over), one at a time, with the span before and after for the hot ones (pick cache, solver caches).
